fields.description: One policy per company. PSAK ID statements can only be prepared for companies that have a policy.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: PSAK 118 statements are available only for companies reporting under SAK Indonesia.
fields.label: Reporting Framework
fields.options:
SAK Indonesia
SAK EP
SAK EMKM
SAK Syariah

fields.description: First day PSAK 118 applies. Statements in that year show the prior year restated for comparison.
fields.label: Adoption Date

fields.description: Tick only if investing or providing financing to customers is a main business activity of the company.
fields.label: Main Business Activities

fields.description: Investment income and expenses marked to follow Operating are shown in the Operating category.
fields.label: Main Business: Investing

fields.description: Financing income and expenses marked to follow Operating are shown in the Operating category.
fields.label: Main Business: Customer Financing

fields.description: Shows all expenses from financing liabilities in Operating. The subtotal Profit or Loss before Financing and Income Taxes is then not presented.
fields.label: All Financing Expenses in Operating

fields.description: Tick when splitting exchange differences by their source would take undue cost or effort. The statement notes this policy.
fields.label: Foreign Exchange Differences in Operating

fields.description: By Function or Mixed adds a note with expenses by nature.
fields.label: Expense Presentation

fields.description: Unit used by default on new statements and exports.
fields.label: Default Unit

fields.description: Prints a heading for each category (Operating, Investing, ...). Off by default: the subtotals already separate the categories.
fields.label: Show Category Headings

fields.description: Letter head printed on the first page of PDF statements.
fields.label: Letter Head

fields.description: An Other Items line above the threshold must be explained in a note before the statement can be sent for review. When both are set, the smaller one applies.
fields.label: Other Items Threshold

fields.description: For information. Used by the compliance calendar in a later release.
fields.label: Audit Required

fields.description: Which criteria of Article 68 of the Company Law the company meets.
fields.label: Audit Criteria

fields.description: Other changes in equity of a component above the threshold are a warning in Mapping Control and must be explained in a quarterly or yearly package. Leave it empty to warn about every amount.
fields.label: Other Changes in Equity Threshold
